options.name: --help

commands.name: report
commands.description: Text overview of a profile: CPU per thread, top functions, GC and allocations

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this message and exit

options.name: --top
options.description: How many threads and functions to list. Default is 12.

options.name: --offsets
options.description:
Also the hot code offsets of the top 3 functions, --top rows each: where in the code of a
function the samples are.

options.name: --thread
options.description: Only the threads whose name contains TEXT.

options.name: --workers
options.description: The parsing threads. Default is half the processors.

options.name: --compact
options.description:
Compact text for AI agents: short section headers, the units in the column names, unpadded
rows with the name last, a total and an omitted line for each list (what it leaves out),
function names without their parameters unless an overload needs them.

options.name: --detailed
options.description:
Also the call trees, in samples with inclusive and self values: top-down for the busiest
threads, bottom-up (the callers) for the top functions by self samples.

options.name: --tree-threads
options.description: With --detailed: how many of the busiest threads get a top-down tree. Default is 3.

options.name: --hotspots
options.description:
With --detailed: how many of the top functions by self samples get a bottom-up tree.
Default is 3.

options.name: --focus
options.description:
The callers and the callees of the functions whose name contains TEXT over all the threads,
instead of the top functions (implies --detailed).

options.name: --collapse-recursion
options.description:
In the trees, the frames of a function from its outermost to its innermost call on a stack
are one (A > F > B > F > C becomes A > F > C): a recursive algorithm shows what its
levels do together instead of a row per level. The self samples do not change.

options.name: --depth
options.description: The rows from the root to the deepest row of a tree. Default is 12.

options.name: --min-percent
options.description:
Leave out the tree rows under PERCENT of their tree (summed in the omitted lines). Default
is 1.

options.name: --max-rows
options.description: The rows of a tree at most, the heaviest first. Default is 40.

options.name: --start-ms
options.description:
Only the samples and markers from MS (ms from the start of the profile, the scale of the
MCP tools).

options.name: --end-ms
options.description:
Only the samples and markers up to MS.
[args]...                  The profile json.gz (or json) file
